I will start with a median combination as it is inherently robust to outliers and varying model performance across windows.

The median performed well given the unstable ranking (tau=0.298) and noisy regime, but it ignores error magnitude differences. I will test a robust weighted combination using inverse error weights on the top 3 models, which balances the trend champion's strength with the recent window winner while mitigating outlier influence via the weighting scheme.

This reduces sensitivity to outliers and poor performers while maintaining diversity across the independent clusters (e.g., including catboost which is less correlated with the linear/exponential models).
